models_evaluated: Pituitary surgery sella segmentation AI-CDSS (Basic vs Enhanced interface)

links.outcome: Clinician trust calibration and performance with confidence labels on AI outlines
links.effect: When AI performed worst, trust was lower in Enhanced group (3.00 vs 3.67, p=.035), sustained in final clip (3.67 vs 4.33, p=.019). Less dispersion in Enhanced when AI inaccurate (IQR 0.07 vs 0.21, p=.004).
links.quote: However, when AI performed worst, trust was significantly lower for the Enhanced group (3.00 vs 3.67, U=668, p=.035), sustained in the final clip (3.67 vs 4.33 U=687, p=.019).

links.outcome: User performance and trust when AI output was inaccurate
links.effect: User performance improved with AI-CDSS overall; Basic group had greater dispersion (IQR 0.21) when AI was inaccurate, and trust remained moderate (3.67) at worst AI performance.
links.quote: There was also less dispersion in the Enhanced group when AI was inaccurate (IQR: 0.07 vs 0.21, p=.004).
